# Hair So Funky

> Hair studio by Felicia Stodghill based in Pflugerville, Texas. Silk presses, color, cuts and relaxer care from Felicia Stodghill, a master stylist with over 36 years behind the chair. She listens, does it exactly how you asked, and shows you how to keep it healthy.

- Phone: (512) 909-5322
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor
- Google rating: 4.7 from 56 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/hair-so-funky-felicia-stodghill-owner-operator/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/hair-so-funky-felicia-stodghill-owner-operator/book.html

## Services
- Silk press: Natural hair smoothed and straightened with swing and shine, done with healthy hair first.
- Color (Funky Hues): From a soft rinse to balayage, color duos and tri-color looks that turn heads.
- Cuts (Shear-Workxx): Pixies, tapered cuts, bobs and shape-ups that frame your face and style easily.
- Relaxed hair care: Shampoo and style, protein repair, relaxer retouches and perms for relaxed hair.
- Natural styles: Coils, flexi rods, twists and crochet braids for natural hair, kept strong and defined.
- Treatments & smoothing: Deep conditioning, protein, hydration steam, hair vitamins and a smoothing treatment.

## About
Hair So Funky is owner-operated by Felicia Stodghill, a master stylist with over 36 years of experience who still works the chair herself, one client at a time. Her hashtags say it best: #Colorchemistry, #shearsmoke and #healthyhairFUNKY. Clients have been reviewing her on Vagaro since 2019, when she was in Hutto, and today the studio is Loft 8 at 1513 Stone Hill Dr in Pflugerville: hot pink walls, painted HAIR SO FUNKY brick, zebra-print chairs and red velvet seats. She works with every hair texture, natural or relaxed, and clients say she cares about the health of your hair over money and teaches you how to keep it up at home.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Hair So Funky's Vagaro page, where you can see the full menu and open times, or call (512) 909-5322. New clients can start with a $30 consultation.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM. Felicia is off the 1st and 3rd Saturday of each month, and Sunday and Monday. Vagaro shows the live openings.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Hair So Funky is by appointment. Call (512) 909-5322 to ask about same-day openings before you head over.
- Q: What is the cancellation policy?
  A: Cancel 48 hours ahead at no charge. Cancelling within 24 hours is charged 50%, and same-day cancellations or no-shows are charged in full.
- Q: Do I need to come in detangled?
  A: Yes, please. For silk presses there is a $50 detangling fee if hair is not detangled, since it takes extra time before the shampoo.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Loft 8, 1513 Stone Hill Dr, Pflugerville, TX 78660, with free parking. An easy drive from Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch and Manor.
